BiblicalUsage: Mahanaim was the place where Jacob saw the angels of God and said this is God's host, and he called the name of that place Mahanaim, two hosts. The name stayed on the map: Abner brought Ish-bosheth there and made him king over Israel, David fled there when Absalom rebelled, and the men of Mahanaim brought him bread and beds and basins in his need.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mahanaim is the place where two hosts meet, the angels of God and the armies of men, and God camps with His people in their worst hour.
RelatedEvents: Jacob Wrestles with God; Absalom's Rebellion
